20: ---
21: 
22: # Verde — Cultivo con criterio
23: 
24: Aplicación web en español para acompañar un autocultivo de cannabis de principio a fin. Combina un simulador de temporada, un diario semanal, un catálogo de autoflorecientes, una biblioteca académica trazable, un oráculo local con fuentes y un presupuesto editable.
25: 
26: > **Marco de trabajo:** autocultivo registrado en Argentina, con un supuesto de 9 plantas autoflorecientes en 15 m² (3 × 5 m). Verde es una herramienta educativa: no vende cannabis, no habilita cultivos fuera del marco legal y no reemplaza asesoramiento profesional.
27: 
28: ## Qué incluye
29: 
30: ### Inicio
31: - Índice real de la aplicación: 8 sectores que muestran su estado y llevan a cada parte.
32: - Estado del batch, biblioteca por curso, extras, insights y accesos rápidos.
33: - Búsqueda global con `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K` sobre sectores, cepas, cursos, PDFs, roadmap y etiquetas.
34: 
35: ### Cepas
36: - Catálogo de 16 autoflorecientes (balanceado: Sativa / Indica / CBD medicinal / Híbrida) con THC/CBD, dificultad, ciclo, rendimiento, altura, efectos, terpenos, linaje y notas de cultivo.
37: - Grilla de **5 columnas** desktop con imágenes compactas; en móvil 2 columnas y en tablet 3–4 sin overflow.
38: - **Categorías Sativa · Indica · CBD · Híbrida** con tabs, select y orden por categoría.
39: - **Fuentes anotadas** por ficha y panel público: StrainAPI V1 (sin key), TheCannabisInformer beta (sin key), Strainpedia demo pública (completa $50/mes) y Otreeba como referencia. No se guarda ninguna API key.
40: - Búsqueda por nombre, efecto, aroma o terpeno; filtros por dificultad y efecto; orden por categoría, THC, ciclo, rendimiento o nombre.
41: - Ficha completa en hoja lateral, con consulta directa al oráculo.
42: 
43: ### Diario
44: - Temporada de 75 días dividida en 11 semanas.
45: - Ambiente semanal con gráfico SVG de temperatura, humedad y VPD.
46: - Checklist por semana, eventos, registro visual y proyección/resultado de cosecha.
47: - Exportación del diario completo a Markdown.
48: 
49: ### Simulador
50: - Sin “avanzar un día”: el flujo es **elegir cepa → configurar → SIMULAR** y ver el proceso completo de inicio a fin.
51: - Configuración: cepa (14), plantas (1–9), días de ciclo (55–90), luz/día y temperatura media, más 6 estrategias (equilibrada, rápida, orgánica, mínima, low-cost e intensiva).
52: - **Timechart multi-serie** estilo Chart Wizard: crecimiento, salud, humedad, nutrición y rendimiento % potencial, con filtros a la izquierda y leyenda a la derecha; cada serie se activa/desactiva al instante.
53: - **Proceso completo** de 12 actividades previstas con día, fase, detalle y estado prevista/omitida.
54: - **5 notas de resultado** mapeadas desde score 0–100: Horrible · Regular · Buena · Muy buena · Excelente, con rendimiento, costo total, $/g y días de estrés.
55: - Benchmark de 6 estrategias con replay exportable en Markdown y JSON.
56: - Vista de invernadero, clima, recursos y bitácora para el cultivo actual (ya no bloquean la simulación).
57: 
58: ### Biblioteca
59: - Índice de 28 recursos demo organizados en 6 diplomaturas.
60: - Vista digerida por defecto: tarjetas de curso con nombre, PDFs, páginas, % cargado y extras.
61: - Índice de sabiduría curso → módulo → recurso, con estado, ruta Markdown, hash y enlaces.
62: - Cada recurso conserva diplomatura, módulo, año, páginas, estado de procesamiento y ruta física.
63: - Búsqueda, filtros, orden, detección de duplicados y comparación de versiones sin borrar el original.
64: - Alta de nuevos PDFs con metadatos de origen y detección de títulos repetidos.
65: - Exportación del índice plano y del índice de sabiduría a Markdown.
66: 
67: ### Roadmap
68: - Página viva de desarrollo con **14 frentes**, **210 hitos**, 4 horizontes, métricas dinámicas, principios, no objetivos y riesgos. Versión **v4.3** (app de estudio: parser PDF→Markdown, presupuestos indoor/outdoor con Mercado Libre, PWA offline, accesibilidad base).
69: - **Ingeniería inversa de 20 apps de cannabis** (catálogos, diarios, marketplaces, sensores, knowledge tools y benchmarks): qué tomar, qué no copiar y qué oportunidad queda libre.
70: - **Radar de 18 oportunidades** priorizadas por impacto, esfuerzo y horizonte.
71: - **Matriz de 12 brechas** con estado actual, ausencia concreta y apuesta de implementación.
72: - Búsqueda sobre los 210 hitos, filtros por frente, horizonte y pendientes; exportación completa a Markdown.
73: - Los hitos completados actualizan el progreso y las métricas del roadmap en vivo.
74: 
75: ### Oráculo
76: - Respuestas locales basadas en una base de conocimiento y en los recursos indexados.
77: - Citas con diplomatura, módulo, identificador y ruta.
78: - Sugerencias de consulta y panel de fuentes navegable.
79: - Aviso legal explícito en preguntas de normativa.
80: 
81: ### Costos
82: - Escenario editable: plantas, rendimiento, precio de referencia, tarifa eléctrica, horas de luz, días y potencia LED.
83: - Cálculo de costo total, por planta y por gramo, valor de referencia y margen.
84: - Distribución del gasto y proyección de escala con advertencias de encuadre.
85: - Guardado del escenario en el navegador.
86: 
87: ### Proceso
88: - Seis fases con objetivos, tareas, focos de atención y costo estimado.
89: - Checklist legal de Argentina y progreso de tareas.
90: - Enlaces al presupuesto y a la biblioteca.
91: 
92: ## Cómo ejecutarlo
93: 
94: No requiere build ni dependencias:
95: 
96: ```bash
97: python3 -m http.server 3002
98: ```
99: 
100: Abrí `http://localhost:3002/`.
101: 
102: También puede servirse con cualquier servidor estático. El estado se guarda en `localStorage` con la clave `verde-app-v2`.
103: 
104: ## Estructura
105: 
106: ```text
107: index.html      Estructura de las 8 vistas, modales, command palette y navegación
108: styles.css      Sistema visual, shell, dashboard y componentes base
109: views.css       Cepas, diario y simulador
110: panels.css      Biblioteca, oráculo, costos, proceso y responsive
111: verde-v3.css    Overlay compacto: índice, biblioteca digerida, batch, roadmap y ⌘K
112: game.js         Estado, simulador, filtros, render, búsqueda global y eventos
113: roadmap.js      Roadmap v4.3: 14 frentes, 221 hitos, 60 hechos, orden de desarrollo, fuera de alcance, 20 apps, 18 apuestas y 12 brechas
114: library.js      Biblioteca demo, fases, checks legales y base del oráculo
115: strains.js      Catálogo demo de 14 autoflorecientes con category + source anotada
116: assets/         Fotografías locales optimizadas
117: ```
118: 
119: ## Datos, fuentes e imágenes
120: 
121: - La biblioteca y las diplomaturas son un **dataset demo** pensado para mostrar provenance, duplicados y citas. No contiene los PDFs originales.
122: - El alta de PDFs guarda metadatos y nombre de archivo en esta versión. La conversión real a Markdown y la búsqueda semántica quedan como siguiente etapa.
123: - El oráculo es una **heurística local**: no envía documentos a terceros y no es un modelo generativo. Sus respuestas citan recursos del índice.
124: - Las fotografías son imágenes de Unsplash incorporadas como material de demostración. No se copiaron assets, marcas ni interfaces de Leafly, Weedmaps, GrowDiaries u otras apps comerciales; el diseño se inspira en patrones de producto (explorador de cepas, diario, ficha de recurso) sin reproducir su identidad visual.
125: - Los perfiles de cepas son síntesis educativas de referencia. No reemplazan la ficha del banco de semillas.
126: 
127: ## Marco legal y límites
128: 
129: Verde parte de un escenario de autocultivo registrado: hasta 9 plantas y 15 m² en el domicilio declarado, sin fines de lucro. Las condiciones concretas dependen de REPROCANN, la jurisdicción y la normativa vigente en 2026.
130: 
131: La app no constituye asesoramiento legal ni médico. No incluye venta, distribución ni recomendaciones terapéuticas individualizadas. Las proyecciones de valor de cosecha son ejercicios de costeo, no una autorización comercial.
132: 
133: ## Supuestos de esta versión
134: 
135: - Temporada de 75 días y 9 autoflorecientes en 15 m².
136: - Indoor con LED de 240 W, 18 horas de luz y tarifa de $95/kWh.
137: - Rendimiento base de 55 g por planta y precio de referencia de $4.500/g.
138: - Datos persistidos solo en el navegador; no hay backend ni cuentas.
139: - El catálogo y la biblioteca son demostrativos y editables desde la interfaz.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Develop Verde as a personal study app focused on medicinal cannabis in Argentina, with a trustworthy study library and a useful run-based simulator.
- Continue implementing and validating agreed improvements proactively.

## Requirements
- Organize PDF materials by course and folder, with carefully extracted Markdown, metadata, tags, sources, and insights; keep demo content distinct from real processed materials.
- Simulator flow: configure → **SIMULAR** → inspect the full-process timechart and compare 4–5 outcomes; label outcomes as estimates, not predictions.
- Keep simulator scenarios synthetic model variations, not empirical probabilities or confidence intervals.
- Improve catalog, readability, navigation, responsive layouts, and Argentina-focused manual price references.
- Keep home a simple book-like index; remove random health and seasonal-cost figures.
- Deprioritize diary, gamification, marketplace, login, and social features; track them under “Cosas que harían la app completa pero que no me interesan.”
- Keep the roadmap editable/exportable and aligned with user priorities.

## Decisions
- Verde is a personal study tool, not a game, marketplace, or social network.
- “Vista digerida” surfaces insights from processed Markdown, separate from source-material ingestion.
- Simulator scenarios are illustrative model variations, not predictions or statistical confidence intervals.
- PDF ingestion is browser-local. Displayed `pdf/` and `md/` paths are references; the static app does not write files into repository folders.

## Work State
### Completed
- Home rebuilt as a seven-chapter app index; random status/cost indicators removed.
- Library supports course/folder PDF covers, local pdf.js extraction, page progress, metadata/tags, scanned-PDF detection, and Markdown/PDF download controls.
- Library search, Oráculo citations, local annotations, and tag-based reading paths with Markdown export are implemented.
- Reading-path creation now uses an inline, accessible form instead of `prompt()`.
- Linked-resource detail now offers a comparison view for course, module, page count, path, and available text, clarifying that links do not prove identical contents.
- Catalog groups strains and shows source information; indoor/outdoor cost views include editable prices, product images, and Mercado Libre verification links.
- PWA manifest/service worker and baseline accessibility improvements are present.
- Simulator generates five deterministic seeded runs, ranks them, displays selectable outcome cards, and updates the timechart/process when selected.
- Simulator outcomes are labeled as synthetic estimates, not predictions or probabilities.
- Added IndexedDB storage for uploaded PDF originals and asynchronous PDF download retrieval; ingestion rejects missing, non-PDF, invalid-signature, and over-40-MB files.
- Clean-profile browser verification passed for text-PDF extraction, scanned-PDF pending state, missing-file and invalid-signature errors, IndexedDB persistence/retrieval after reload, Markdown/PDF downloads after reload, and >40 MB rejection.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check game.js`, `node --check roadmap.js`, and `node --check strains.js` passed in the prior work session.

### Active
- Research and document free cannabis-related APIs, access/key requirements, licensing, attribution, and appropriate data-source handling.
- Reconcile roadmap counts/statuses and non-priorities with current scope; update `README.md` and roadmap to match verified functionality.
- Run broader desktop/mobile smoke tests and verify simulator selection behavior in the current build.

### Blocked
- OCR for scanned PDFs is not implemented; parser detects likely image-only PDFs and recommends OCR.
- External API research and verification remain undone.
- No reference simulator timechart image is available for exact visual comparison.

## Next Move
1. Research and document appropriate free APIs, including license and attribution details.
2. Update README and roadmap based on verified behavior, reconciling counts, statuses, and out-of-scope priorities.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks, desktop/mobile smoke tests, and simulator outcome-selection checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Simulator, PDF parsing and IndexedDB storage, library search, annotations, reading paths, comparison view, and cost behavior.
- `index.html`: App views, simulator results/configuration, library, and PDF ingestion interface.
- `verde-v3.css`: UI refinements, responsive simulator/library styling, reading-path form, and linked-resource comparison.
- `sw.js`: Service-worker cache version and assets.
- `roadmap.js`: Roadmap streams, milestones, and status/count logic.
- `README.md`: Project documentation; stale on roadmap counts and implemented PDF behavior.
- `library.js`: Library resources, course metadata, and digest data.
- `strains.js`: Strain catalog and source data.
- `pdf/README.md`: PDF source-directory conventions; clarifies demo dataset has no real PDF binaries.
- `md/01_CultivoInterior/M4/03_riego_sustrato.md`: Unverified short Markdown sample.
- `/tmp/opencode/test_pdf_clean.py`: Clean-profile CDP browser verification script; now covers downloads and oversize rejection.
- `/tmp/opencode/oversize.pdf`: 40 MiB+ fixture used for size-limit validation.

## Important Context
- Working tree has uncommitted changes in `game.js`, `index.html`, `sw.js`, and `verde-v3.css`; the latest edits added the inline reading-path form and linked-resource comparison in `game.js` and `verde-v3.css`.
- The clean-profile test passed all cases, including Markdown download `030_text_sample.md`, PDF download `text-sample.pdf` from IndexedDB after reload, and the message `El PDF supera el límite de 40 MB. Reducí su tamaño e intentá de nuevo.` The test resource count remained 2 after rejection.
- Roadmap currently identifies itself as v4.4, while `README.md` still documents v4.3 and conflicting milestone totals.

22: # Verde — Cultivo con criterio
23: 
24: Aplicación web en español para acompañar un autocultivo de cannabis de principio a fin. Combina un simulador de temporada, un diario semanal, un catálogo de autoflorecientes, una biblioteca académica trazable, un oráculo local con fuentes y un presupuesto editable.
25: 
26: > **Marco de trabajo:** autocultivo registrado en Argentina, con un supuesto de 9 plantas autoflorecientes en 15 m² (3 × 5 m). Verde es una herramienta educativa: no vende cannabis, no habilita cultivos fuera del marco legal y no reemplaza asesoramiento profesional.
27: 
28: ## Qué incluye
29: 
30: ### Inicio
31: - Índice real de la aplicación: 8 sectores que muestran su estado y llevan a cada parte.
32: - Estado del batch, biblioteca por curso, extras, insights y accesos rápidos.
33: - Búsqueda global con `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K` sobre sectores, cepas, cursos, PDFs, roadmap y etiquetas.
34: 
35: ### Cepas
36: - Catálogo de 16 autoflorecientes (balanceado: Sativa / Indica / CBD medicinal / Híbrida) con THC/CBD, dificultad, ciclo, rendimiento, altura, efectos, terpenos, linaje y notas de cultivo.
37: - Grilla de **5 columnas** desktop con imágenes compactas; en móvil 2 columnas y en tablet 3–4 sin overflow.
38: - **Categorías Sativa · Indica · CBD · Híbrida** con tabs, select y orden por categoría.
39: - **Fuentes anotadas** por ficha y panel público: StrainAPI V1 (sin key), TheCannabisInformer beta (sin key), Strainpedia demo pública (completa $50/mes) y Otreeba como referencia. No se guarda ninguna API key.
40: - Búsqueda por nombre, efecto, aroma o terpeno; filtros por dificultad y efecto; orden por categoría, THC, ciclo, rendimiento o nombre.
41: - Ficha completa en hoja lateral, con consulta directa al oráculo.
42: 
43: ### Diario
44: - Temporada de 75 días dividida en 11 semanas.
45: - Ambiente semanal con gráfico SVG de temperatura, humedad y VPD.
46: - Checklist por semana, eventos, registro visual y proyección/resultado de cosecha.
47: - Exportación del diario completo a Markdown.
48: 
49: ### Simulador
50: - Sin “avanzar un día”: el flujo es **elegir cepa → configurar → SIMULAR** y ver el proceso completo de inicio a fin.
51: - Configuración: cepa (14), plantas (1–9), días de ciclo (55–90), luz/día y temperatura media, más 6 estrategias (equilibrada, rápida, orgánica, mínima, low-cost e intensiva).
52: - **Timechart multi-serie** estilo Chart Wizard: crecimiento, salud, humedad, nutrición y rendimiento % potencial, con filtros a la izquierda y leyenda a la derecha; cada serie se activa/desactiva al instante.
53: - **Proceso completo** de 12 actividades previstas con día, fase, detalle y estado prevista/omitida.
54: - **5 notas de resultado** mapeadas desde score 0–100: Horrible · Regular · Buena · Muy buena · Excelente, con rendimiento, costo total, $/g y días de estrés.
55: - Benchmark de 6 estrategias con replay exportable en Markdown y JSON.
56: - Vista de invernadero, clima, recursos y bitácora para el cultivo actual (ya no bloquean la simulación).
57: 
58: ### Biblioteca
59: - Índice de 28 recursos demo organizados en 6 diplomaturas.
60: - Vista digerida por defecto: tarjetas de curso con nombre, PDFs, páginas, % cargado y extras.
61: - Índice de sabiduría curso → módulo → recurso, con estado, ruta Markdown, hash y enlaces.
62: - Cada recurso conserva diplomatura, módulo, año, páginas, estado de procesamiento y ruta física.
63: - Búsqueda, filtros, orden, detección de duplicados y comparación de versiones sin borrar el original.
64: - Alta de nuevos PDFs con metadatos de origen y detección de títulos repetidos.
65: - Exportación del índice plano y del índice de sabiduría a Markdown.
66: 
67: ### Roadmap
68: - Página viva de desarrollo con **14 frentes**, **210 hitos**, 4 horizontes, métricas dinámicas, principios, no objetivos y riesgos. Versión **v4.3** (app de estudio: parser PDF→Markdown, presupuestos indoor/outdoor con Mercado Libre, PWA offline, accesibilidad base).
69: - **Ingeniería inversa de 20 apps de cannabis** (catálogos, diarios, marketplaces, sensores, knowledge tools y benchmarks): qué tomar, qué no copiar y qué oportunidad queda libre.
70: - **Radar de 18 oportunidades** priorizadas por impacto, esfuerzo y horizonte.
71: - **Matriz de 12 brechas** con estado actual, ausencia concreta y apuesta de implementación.
72: - Búsqueda sobre los 210 hitos, filtros por frente, horizonte y pendientes; exportación completa a Markdown.
73: - Los hitos completados actualizan el progreso y las métricas del roadmap en vivo.

92: ## Cómo ejecutarlo
93: 
94: No requiere build ni dependencias:
95: 
96: ```bash
97: python3 -m http.server 3002
98: ```
99: 
100: Abrí `http://localhost:3002/`.
101: 
102: También puede servirse con cualquier servidor estático. El estado se guarda en `localStorage` con la clave `verde-app-v2`.
103: 
104: ## Estructura
105: 
106: ```text
107: index.html      Estructura de las 8 vistas, modales, command palette y navegación
108: styles.css      Sistema visual, shell, dashboard y componentes base
109: views.css       Cepas, diario y simulador
110: panels.css      Biblioteca, oráculo, costos, proceso y responsive
111: verde-v3.css    Overlay compacto: índice, biblioteca digerida, batch, roadmap y ⌘K
112: game.js         Estado, simulador, filtros, render, búsqueda global y eventos
113: roadmap.js      Roadmap v4.3: 14 frentes, 221 hitos, 60 hechos, orden de desarrollo, fuera de alcance, 20 apps, 18 apuestas y 12 brechas
114: library.js      Biblioteca demo, fases, checks legales y base del oráculo
115: strains.js      Catálogo demo de 14 autoflorecientes con category + source anotada
116: assets/         Fotografías locales optimizadas
117: ```
118: 
119: ## Datos, fuentes e imágenes
120: 
121: - La biblioteca y las diplomaturas son un **dataset demo** pensado para mostrar provenance, duplicados y citas. No contiene los PDFs originales.
122: - El alta de PDFs guarda metadatos y nombre de archivo en esta versión. La conversión real a Markdown y la búsqueda semántica quedan como siguiente etapa.
123: - El oráculo es una **heurística local**: no envía documentos a terceros y no es un modelo generativo. Sus respuestas citan recursos del índice.
124: - Las fotografías son imágenes de Unsplash incorporadas como material de demostración. No se copiaron assets, marcas ni interfaces de Leafly, Weedmaps, GrowDiaries u otras apps comerciales; el diseño se inspira en patrones de producto (explorador de cepas, diario, ficha de recurso) sin reproducir su identidad visual.
125: - Los perfiles de cepas son síntesis educativas de referencia. No reemplazan la ficha del banco de semillas.
126: 
127: ## Marco legal y límites
128: 
129: Verde parte de un escenario de autocultivo registrado: hasta 9 plantas y 15 m² en el domicilio declarado, sin fines de lucro. Las condiciones concretas dependen de REPROCANN, la jurisdicción y la normativa vigente en 2026.
130: 
131: La app no constituye asesoramiento legal ni médico. No incluye venta, distribución ni recomendaciones terapéuticas individualizadas. Las proyecciones de valor de cosecha son ejercicios de costeo, no una autorización comercial.
132: 
133: ## Supuestos de esta versión
134: 
135: - Temporada de 75 días y 9 autoflorecientes en 15 m².
136: - Indoor con LED de 240 W, 18 horas de luz y tarifa de $95/kWh.
137: - Rendimiento base de 55 g por planta y precio de referencia de $4.500/g.
138: - Datos persistidos solo en el navegador; no hay backend ni cuentas.
139: - El catálogo y la biblioteca son demostrativos y editables desde la interfaz.

StrainAPI V1 • Developer Documentation
StrainAPI Developer Documentation
Build with structured cannabis strain data using the public, read-only StrainAPI REST API. Start with one GET request, search the database, browse published strains, or retrieve a detailed individual record.

Versionv1StatusLive
AuthenticationNoneFormatJSON
ProtocolHTTPSAccessRead-only




On this page
Quick StartBase URLEndpoints
PaginationResponsesField Reference
Code ExamplesErrorsCORS & Caching
Request LimitsVersioningUsage & Disclaimer




30-second quick startMake your first request.
No API key is currently required. Send a GET request and receive JSON.
curl "https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains?per_page=5"
Example record shape:
{
  "id": 3209,
  "name": "Swoon",
  "slug": "swoon",
  "breeder": "Cresco Labs x Purple City Genetics",
  "genetics": "F1 Durb x Gushers x Street Guru",
  "type": "Hybrid",
  "thc": {
    "value": null,
    "min": 19.85,
    "max": 27.99,
    "unit": "%"
  },
  "terpenes": ["Limonene", "Beta-Caryophyllene", "Myrcene"]
}
Live data: Example values illustrate the API structure. Records may change as the database is updated. Applications should treat live API responses as the current data source.


Base URLhttps://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1All documented V1 routes use this namespace.

EndpointsV1 exposes three public GET endpoints.

GET/strains
List cannabis strainsReturns published strains in the compact response format. Use it for browsing, listings, synchronization, and paginated datasets.
GET https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains
ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
pageinteger1Results page; minimum 1.
per_pageinteger20Records per page; maximum 100.
GET https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains?per_page=20&page=1


GET/strains/{slug}
Retrieve one strainReturns the detailed record for one published strain. Detailed records include additional fields such as description/content, effects, evidence, publication data, and cultivation information when available.
GET https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains/swoon


GET/search?q={query}
Search strainsSearches published strain records and returns compact results.
ParameterTypeDescriptionqstringSearch query, such as a strain name.
GET https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/search?q=swoon



Pagination
Use page and per_page with the collection endpoint. The default is 20 records per page and the maximum is 100.
GET https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains?per_page=100&page=1
Collection responses expose X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages headers for total records and total pages.


Response structure
Compact recordsCollection and search endpoints return efficient records for discovery and listings. Full description/content is intentionally omitted.
Full recordsThe individual endpoint returns additional available fields including content, effects, evidence, publication data, and cultivation details.
Missing dataStrainAPI does not invent missing information. Missing scalar/object values can be null; missing lists can be []. Clients should handle both.


Field referenceField availability depends on the source strain record.
FieldTypeDescription
idintegerPublic record identifier.
namestringCanonical API strain name.
display_titlestringFull WordPress display title on detailed records.
slugstringURL-safe identifier used by the detail endpoint.
urlstringPublic strain webpage.
excerptstring/nullShort summary when available.
imageobject/nullFeatured image URL, dimensions, and alt text.
breederstring/nullDocumented breeder information.
geneticsstring/nullKnown or reported lineage.
typestring/nullCultivar type classification.
indica_percentnumber/nullReported indica percentage.
sativa_percentnumber/nullReported sativa percentage.
seed_typestring/nullSeed type when documented.
thcobjectTHC value/range and percent unit.
cbdobjectCBD value/range and percent unit.
terpenesarrayDocumented terpene names.
floweringobjectMinimum/maximum flowering days.
aromamixedDocumented aroma information.
flavormixedDocumented flavor information.
outdoor_harveststring/nullDetailed-record harvest information.
plant_structurestring/nullDetailed-record plant structure.
yieldstring/nullDetailed-record yield information.
effectsobjectMental/body effects when documented.
evidenceobject/arrayEvidence states exposed by the detailed record.
published_atstring/nullPublication timestamp.
updated_atstring/nullLast update timestamp where exposed.
descriptionstring/nullDetailed plain-text/content description.
content_htmlstring/nullDetailed HTML content.

Evidence states: where evidence states are exposed, V1 restricts them to supported, reported, disputed, and insufficient_data.


Code examplesThe same public endpoint can be called from common development environments.

cURLJavaScriptPythonPHP

curl "https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains/swoon"
const response = await fetch(
  "https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains/swoon"
);

if (!response.ok) {
  throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
}

const strain = await response.json();
console.log(strain);
import requests

url = "https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains/swoon"
response = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
response.raise_for_status()

strain = response.json()
print(strain)
$url = 'https://www.strainapi.com/wp-json/strainapi/v1/strains/swoon';
$response = wp_remote_get($url);

if (!is_wp_error($response)) {
    $strain = json_decode(
        wp_remote_retrieve_body($response),
        true
    );
}


Errors
Clients should check the HTTP status before processing a response. Invalid parameters, missing required search input, or a strain slug that does not resolve may produce a WordPress REST error response.
{
  "code": "error_code",
  "message": "Human-readable error message",
  "data": {
    "status": 404
  }
}
Do not build against the example error-code string above. Use the returned HTTP status and live error response.


CORS & caching
V1 is designed for public GET access and includes CORS support for GET/OPTIONS requests. Responses may be cached to improve performance.
BehaviorV1
CORSPublic origin access for GET/OPTIONS; credentials are not required.
Cache-Controlpublic, max-age=60, s-maxage=300
Version headerX-StrainAPI-Version: v1



Request limits
StrainAPI applies reasonable request limits to help maintain service availability. Applications should cache responses where appropriate, avoid unnecessary repeated requests, and use pagination responsibly.
Developer note: Exact public usage limits and access policies may evolve as the service grows. Do not design an application around an assumed unlimited request rate.


Versioning
The current public namespace is /v1/. V1 is intended to remain backward-compatible. If a future change requires a breaking API contract, it should be introduced under a new version rather than silently changing V1 behavior.
/wp-json/strainapi/v1/...


Usage & disclaimer
StrainAPI provides cannabis cultivar information for informational, educational, scientific, botanical, research, and development purposes. Data availability and confidence can vary by cultivar and source record. Applications should preserve uncertainty rather than converting missing, reported, or disputed information into factual claims.
API availability, documentation, limits, and policies may be updated as the service develops. Developers should periodically review this documentation before relying on operational assumptions.

    Cannabis Strain API for Developers

Programmatic access to Strainpedia's structured cannabis cultivar database.

The Strainpedia Cannabis Strain API returns JSON records for published cultivars, including available genetics and lineage, strain type, THC and CBD ranges, cannabinoids, terpenes, reported effects, flavors, aromas, images, and canonical Strainpedia URLs.

Developers can retrieve individual strains, search and compare records, filter numeric THC/CBD ranges, and discover strains by effect, flavor, or terpene. The API is designed for apps, AI tools, research interfaces, directories, WordPress integrations, WooCommerce projects, and other software that needs structured strain data.

    Cannabis Strain Data Available Through the API

    Each response is built from Strainpedia's published cultivar records. Field availability varies by strain, but supported records can expose the following data without requiring developers to scrape or reconstruct the encyclopedia pages.

    
      
        
          
            Field
            Description
          
          idInternal WordPress post ID
          nameStrain name
          slugUnique strain URL slug
          urlCanonical Strainpedia page URL
          excerptShort public summary of the strain page
          featured_imageFeatured strain image URL, when available
          categoriesHuman-readable category names
          category_slugsMachine-readable category slugs
          typeIndica, sativa, hybrid, or related classification where available
          geneticsKnown or reported genetic lineage where available
          thc_rangeReported THC range where available
          cbd_rangeReported CBD range where available
          thc_min / thc_maxNormalized numeric THC boundaries, or null when unavailable
          cbd_min / cbd_maxNormalized numeric CBD boundaries, or null when unavailable
          cannabinoidsNested THC and CBD objects containing text, minimum, maximum, and unit
          terpenesReported terpene profile where available
          effectsReported effects or use-case notes where available
          flavorsFlavor notes where available
          aromaAroma notes where available
          flowering_timeGeneral flowering-time information where available
          difficultyGeneral grower difficulty notes where available
          yield_potentialGeneral yield potential where available
          created_atRecord publication timestamp in ISO 8601 format
          updated_atRecord modification timestamp in ISO 8601 format
        
      
    

    Note: Structured fields are being expanded over time. Some fields may be blank for certain strains while the dataset is being improved.
  

  
    Cannabis Strain API Endpoints

    Public Demo Endpoints
    Returns limited demo data for approved sample strains. No API key required.
    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/demo/blue-dream
GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/demo/gelato
GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/demo/og-kush
GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/demo/northern-lights
GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/demo/girl-scout-cookies

    All Strains
    Returns a paginated and filterable collection. page_size is recommended; legacy per_page remains supported.
    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains?page=1&page_size=20
GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains?strain_type=hybrid&min_thc=15&max_thc=25
GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains?effect=relaxing&flavor=berry&terpene=myrcene
GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains?orderby=thc&order=desc

    Search Strains
    Search strains by keyword with pagination and the same filters available on the collection endpoint.
    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/search?q=cherry&page=1&page_size=20
    The aliases search and legacy query are also supported.

    Single Strain
    Get one strain by slug.
    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strain/blue-dream

    Compare Strains
    Compare multiple strains by slug.
    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/compare?strains=blue-dream,gelato

    Effects Catalog
    Discover normalized effect names, URL-safe slugs, and matching strain counts.
    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/effects?orderby=count&order=desc&page=1&page_size=50

    Flavors Catalog
    Discover flavor names, slugs, and matching strain counts.
    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/flavors?page=1&page_size=50

    Terpenes Catalog
    Discover terpene names, slugs, and matching strain counts.
    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/terpenes?page=1&page_size=50

    Catalog endpoints support q, page, page_size, orderby=name|count, and order=asc|desc. Catalog page size is capped at 100.

    Catalog-to-Strain Discovery
    Follow any catalog slug directly to a filtered, paginated strain collection.

GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/flavors/berry/strains

    Cannabis API Authentication

    The Strainpedia API is private and requires an approved developer API key.

    Send your API key in the request header:

    x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY_HERE

    cURL Example

    curl -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY_HERE" \
https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains

    JavaScript Example

    fetch('https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains', {
  headers: {
    'x-api-key': 'YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
  }
})
.then(response => response.json())
.then(data => console.log(data))
.catch(error => console.error(error));

    PHP Example

    $response = wp_remote_get('https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains', [
  'headers' => [
    'x-api-key' => 'YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
  ]
]);

$data = json_decode(wp_remote_retrieve_body($response), true);
  

  
    Pagination, Filtering, and Sorting

    The all-strains and search endpoints return 20 records per page by default. The maximum page_size is 50.

    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains?page=1&page_size=20&strain_type=hybrid&min_thc=15&max_thc=25

    Supported parameters include page, page_size, search, q, strain_type, min_thc, max_thc, min_cbd, max_cbd, effect, flavor, terpene, orderby, and order.

    Collection responses include items, pagination, and filters. The legacy data, page, per_page, total, and total_pages fields remain available for existing integrations.

    Usage Rules

    To protect Strainpedia and keep the API fair for approved developers, all API users must follow these rules:

    
      Strainpedia must be credited inside your app or website with a visible link to https://www.strainpedia.com/.
      API access is for app display, integration, and approved development use only.
      Data may not be copied, resold, bulk-exported, scraped, or republished as a separate database.
      Full article content is not included unless separately approved in writing.
      Commercial or production use is allowed only while the subscription is active.
      API keys may not be shared publicly or distributed to third parties.
      Access may be suspended or revoked for abusive usage, excessive requests, scraping behavior, or violation of these terms.
    
  

  
    Attribution Requirement

    Apps and websites using Strainpedia API data must include visible attribution, such as:

    
      Data provided by Strainpedia
    

    The attribution should appear near the strain data, in a source section, or in another visible area of the app where users can reasonably see the source.
  

  
    Data Use and Educational Disclaimer

    Strainpedia provides cannabis strain reference information for educational, comparison, and app-integration purposes. Strain data may vary by breeder, grower, phenotype, region, lab testing method, and source availability.

    The API is not intended to provide medical, legal, cultivation, or purchasing advice. Developers are responsible for how Strainpedia data is displayed and used within their own applications.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is a cannabis strain API?
    A cannabis strain API gives developers programmatic access to structured strain information. The Strainpedia Cannabis Strain API returns JSON data for strain names, genetics, cannabinoid ranges, terpenes, effects, flavors, aromas, images, URLs, and other supported fields where available.

    Is Strainpedia a cannabis strain database API?
    Yes. Strainpedia provides a cannabis strain database API that developers can use to retrieve structured strain information, including names, genetics, cannabinoid ranges, terpenes, effects, flavors, aromas, images, categories, and canonical source URLs where available.

    Does the cannabis API return JSON?
    Yes. Strainpedia is a REST API that returns structured JSON responses that developers can use in websites, mobile apps, AI tools, search interfaces, directories, WordPress integrations, and other software.

    Can I search and look up cannabis strains through the API?
    Yes. Paid access includes paginated keyword search, an all-strains collection, single-strain lookup by slug, multi-strain comparison, and discovery routes for effects, flavors, and terpenes.

    Does the API include cannabis genetics and lineage?
    Yes, where available. The genetics field provides known or reported genetic lineage for supported strain records. Data availability can vary by cultivar and source.

    Does the cannabis strain API include terpene and cannabinoid data?
    Yes, where available. Supported records can include reported terpene profiles, THC and CBD ranges, normalized numeric THC/CBD boundaries, and nested cannabinoid data. Paid endpoints also support terpene filtering and a dedicated terpene discovery catalog.

    Can I use the cannabis API with WordPress or WooCommerce?
    Yes. Active subscribers receive the official Strainpedia WordPress Client Pro plugin, which supports Strainpedia Strains, WordPress Posts, WordPress Pages, and WooCommerce Products.

Is the Strainpedia API free?
    No. The Strainpedia API is offered as a paid developer subscription at $50/month. This helps support hosting, maintenance, development, and ongoing data organization.

    Can I test the API before subscribing?
    Yes. Use the Strainpedia API Playground to test the public demo without a key, explore protected endpoints with a temporary developer key, generate integration code, and download the Developer Starter Kit. Full endpoints require a developer subscription.

    Can I filter strains by THC, CBD, effects, flavors, or terpenes?
    Yes. Paid API access supports numeric THC/CBD range filters, strain-type filtering, effect/flavor/terpene filters, pagination, and sorting. Dedicated effects, flavors, and terpenes catalogs also provide stable slugs and matching strain counts.

    Can I cancel anytime?
    Yes. The developer subscription is month-to-month and can be cancelled anytime.

    How many API requests are included?
    The Developer API Plan includes up to 200,000 requests per month.

    Is the WordPress plugin included?
    Yes. The official Strainpedia WordPress Client Pro plugin is included with every active Strainpedia API subscription. It supports Strainpedia Strains, WordPress Posts, WordPress Pages, and WooCommerce Products.

    Does the API include full article content?
    No. Standard API access does not include full article content. The API is designed to provide structured strain data for apps and integrations while protecting Strainpedia’s original editorial content.

    Can I use the data in a commercial app?
    Yes, commercial or app use is allowed while your subscription is active and your usage follows the API terms.

    Can I resell or export the data?
    No. Strainpedia API data may not be copied, resold, bulk-exported, scraped, or republished as a separate database.

    Do I need to credit Strainpedia?
    Yes. Apps and websites using Strainpedia API data must include visible attribution with a link to https://www.strainpedia.com/.

    What happens if I exceed my monthly limit?
    Your API access may stop responding until the next monthly cycle, or you may contact us to discuss a higher-volume plan.

    Can I get a higher request limit?
    Yes. Higher-volume access may be available for approved partners depending on usage needs.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Develop Verde as a personal study app focused on medicinal cannabis in Argentina, with a trustworthy study library and a useful run-based simulator.
- Continue implementing and validating agreed improvements proactively.

## Requirements
- Organize PDF materials by course and folder, with carefully extracted Markdown, metadata, tags, sources, and insights; keep demo content distinct from real processed materials.
- Simulator flow: configure → **SIMULAR** → inspect the full-process timechart and compare 4–5 outcomes; label outcomes as estimates, not predictions.
- Use synthetic model variations, not empirical probabilities or confidence intervals.
- Improve catalog, readability, navigation, responsive layouts, and Argentina-focused manual price references.
- Keep home a simple book-like index; remove random health and seasonal-cost figures.
- Deprioritize diary, gamification, marketplace, login, and social features; track them under “Cosas que harían la app completa pero que no me interesan.”
- Keep the roadmap editable/exportable and aligned with user priorities.

## Decisions
- Verde is a personal study tool, not a game, marketplace, or social network.
- “Vista digerida” surfaces insights from processed Markdown, separate from source-material ingestion.
- Simulator scenarios are illustrative model variations, not predictions or statistical confidence intervals.
- PDF ingestion is browser-local. Displayed `pdf/` and `md/` paths are references; the static app does not write files into repository folders.

## Work State
### Completed
- Home rebuilt as a seven-chapter app index; random status/cost indicators removed.
- Library supports course/folder PDF covers, local pdf.js extraction, page progress, metadata/tags, scanned-PDF detection, and Markdown/PDF download controls.
- Library search, Oráculo citations, local annotations, and tag-based reading paths with Markdown export are implemented.
- Reading-path creation now uses an inline accessible form instead of `prompt()`.
- Linked-resource detail offers a comparison view for course, module, page count, path, and available text, clarifying that links do not prove identical contents.
- Catalog groups strains and shows source information; indoor/outdoor cost views include editable prices, product images, and Mercado Libre verification links.
- PWA manifest/service worker and baseline accessibility improvements are present.
- Simulator generates five deterministic seeded runs, ranks them, displays selectable outcome cards, and updates the timechart/process when selected.
- Simulator outcomes are labeled as synthetic estimates, not predictions or probabilities.
- Added IndexedDB storage for uploaded PDF originals and asynchronous PDF download retrieval; ingestion rejects missing, non-PDF, invalid-signature, and over-40-MB files.
- Clean-profile browser verification passed PDF extraction, scanned-PDF pending state, missing-file and invalid-signature errors, IndexedDB persistence/retrieval after reload, and Markdown/PDF downloads after reload.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check game.js`, `node --check roadmap.js`, and `node --check strains.js` passed in the prior work session.

### Active
- Research and document free cannabis-related APIs, access/key requirements, licensing, attribution, and appropriate data-source handling.
- Reconcile roadmap counts/statuses and non-priorities with current scope; update `README.md` and roadmap to match verified functionality.
- Run broader desktop/mobile smoke tests and verify simulator outcome-selection behavior in the current build.

### Blocked
- OCR for scanned PDFs is not implemented; parser detects likely image-only PDFs and recommends OCR.
- External API research and verification remain undone.
- No reference simulator timechart image is available for exact visual comparison.

## Next Move
1. Research and document appropriate free APIs, including license and attribution details.
2. Update `README.md` and `roadmap.js` based on verified behavior, reconciling counts, statuses, and out-of-scope priorities.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks, desktop/mobile smoke tests, and simulator outcome-selection checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Simulator, PDF parsing and IndexedDB storage, library search, annotations, reading paths, comparison view, and cost behavior.
- `index.html`: App views, simulator results/configuration, library, and PDF ingestion interface.
- `verde-v3.css`: UI refinements, responsive simulator/library styling, reading-path form, and linked-resource comparison.
- `sw.js`: Service-worker cache version and assets.
- `roadmap.js`: Roadmap streams, milestones, and status/count logic.
- `README.md`: Project documentation; stale on roadmap counts and implemented PDF behavior.
- `library.js`: Library resources, course metadata, and digest data.
- `strains.js`: Strain catalog and source data.
- `pdf/README.md`: PDF source-directory conventions and demo dataset clarification.
- `md/01_CultivoInterior/M4/03_riego_sustrato.md`: Unverified short Markdown sample.
- `/tmp/opencode/test_pdf_clean.py`: Clean-profile CDP browser verification script.
- `/tmp/opencode/oversize.pdf`: 40 MiB+ fixture used for size-limit validation.

## Important Context
- Working tree has uncommitted changes in `game.js`, `index.html`, `sw.js`, and `verde-v3.css`; recent changes also add inline reading-path creation and linked-resource comparison.
- The clean-profile test passed extraction, scanned-pending detection, persistence/reload, and Markdown/PDF download checks. Oversize rejection was initially verified, but a later rerun failed at the Markdown download assertion after those checks; review `/tmp/opencode/test_pdf_clean.py` and rerun before relying on the complete suite.
- Roadmap identifies itself as v4.4 (November 2026); `README.md` still documents v4.3 and conflicting milestone totals.

20: ---
21: 
22: # Verde — Cultivo con criterio
23: 
24: Aplicación web en español para acompañar un autocultivo de cannabis de principio a fin. Combina un simulador de temporada, un diario semanal, un catálogo de autoflorecientes, una biblioteca académica trazable, un oráculo local con fuentes y un presupuesto editable.
25: 
26: > **Marco de trabajo:** autocultivo registrado en Argentina, con un supuesto de 9 plantas autoflorecientes en 15 m² (3 × 5 m). Verde es una herramienta educativa: no vende cannabis, no habilita cultivos fuera del marco legal y no reemplaza asesoramiento profesional.
27: 
28: ## Qué incluye
29: 
30: ### Inicio
31: - Índice real de la aplicación: 8 sectores que muestran su estado y llevan a cada parte.
32: - Estado del batch, biblioteca por curso, extras, insights y accesos rápidos.
33: - Búsqueda global con `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K` sobre sectores, cepas, cursos, PDFs, roadmap y etiquetas.
34: 
35: ### Cepas
36: - Catálogo de 16 autoflorecientes (balanceado: Sativa / Indica / CBD medicinal / Híbrida) con THC/CBD, dificultad, ciclo, rendimiento, altura, efectos, terpenos, linaje y notas de cultivo.
37: - Grilla de **5 columnas** desktop con imágenes compactas; en móvil 2 columnas y en tablet 3–4 sin overflow.
38: - **Categorías Sativa · Indica · CBD · Híbrida** con tabs, select y orden por categoría.
39: - **Fuentes anotadas** por ficha y panel público: StrainAPI V1 (sin key), TheCannabisInformer beta (sin key), Strainpedia demo pública (completa $50/mes) y Otreeba como referencia. No se guarda ninguna API key.
40: - Búsqueda por nombre, efecto, aroma o terpeno; filtros por dificultad y efecto; orden por categoría, THC, ciclo, rendimiento o nombre.
41: - Ficha completa en hoja lateral, con consulta directa al oráculo.
42: 
43: ### Diario
44: - Temporada de 75 días dividida en 11 semanas.
45: - Ambiente semanal con gráfico SVG de temperatura, humedad y VPD.
46: - Checklist por semana, eventos, registro visual y proyección/resultado de cosecha.
47: - Exportación del diario completo a Markdown.
48: 
49: ### Simulador
50: - Sin “avanzar un día”: el flujo es **elegir cepa → configurar → SIMULAR** y ver el proceso completo de inicio a fin.
51: - Configuración: cepa (14), plantas (1–9), días de ciclo (55–90), luz/día y temperatura media, más 6 estrategias (equilibrada, rápida, orgánica, mínima, low-cost e intensiva).
52: - **Timechart multi-serie** estilo Chart Wizard: crecimiento, salud, humedad, nutrición y rendimiento % potencial, con filtros a la izquierda y leyenda a la derecha; cada serie se activa/desactiva al instante.
53: - **Proceso completo** de 12 actividades previstas con día, fase, detalle y estado prevista/omitida.
54: - **5 notas de resultado** mapeadas desde score 0–100: Horrible · Regular · Buena · Muy buena · Excelente, con rendimiento, costo total, $/g y días de estrés.
55: - Benchmark de 6 estrategias con replay exportable en Markdown y JSON.
56: - Vista de invernadero, clima, recursos y bitácora para el cultivo actual (ya no bloquean la simulación).
57: 
58: ### Biblioteca
59: - Índice de 28 recursos demo organizados en 6 diplomaturas.
60: - Vista digerida por defecto: tarjetas de curso con nombre, PDFs, páginas, % cargado y extras.
61: - Índice de sabiduría curso → módulo → recurso, con estado, ruta Markdown, hash y enlaces.
62: - Cada recurso conserva diplomatura, módulo, año, páginas, estado de procesamiento y ruta física.
63: - Búsqueda, filtros, orden, detección de duplicados y comparación de versiones sin borrar el original.
64: - Alta de nuevos PDFs con metadatos de origen y detección de títulos repetidos.
65: - Exportación del índice plano y del índice de sabiduría a Markdown.
66: 
67: ### Roadmap
68: - Página viva de desarrollo con **14 frentes**, **210 hitos**, 4 horizontes, métricas dinámicas, principios, no objetivos y riesgos. Versión **v4.3** (app de estudio: parser PDF→Markdown, presupuestos indoor/outdoor con Mercado Libre, PWA offline, accesibilidad base).
69: - **Ingeniería inversa de 20 apps de cannabis** (catálogos, diarios, marketplaces, sensores, knowledge tools y benchmarks): qué tomar, qué no copiar y qué oportunidad queda libre.
70: - **Radar de 18 oportunidades** priorizadas por impacto, esfuerzo y horizonte.
71: - **Matriz de 12 brechas** con estado actual, ausencia concreta y apuesta de implementación.
72: - Búsqueda sobre los 210 hitos, filtros por frente, horizonte y pendientes; exportación completa a Markdown.
73: - Los hitos completados actualizan el progreso y las métricas del roadmap en vivo.
74: 
75: ### Oráculo
76: - Respuestas locales basadas en una base de conocimiento y en los recursos indexados.
77: - Citas con diplomatura, módulo, identificador y ruta.
78: - Sugerencias de consulta y panel de fuentes navegable.
79: - Aviso legal explícito en preguntas de normativa.
80: 
81: ### Costos
82: - Escenario editable: plantas, rendimiento, precio de referencia, tarifa eléctrica, horas de luz, días y potencia LED.
83: - Cálculo de costo total, por planta y por gramo, valor de referencia y margen.
84: - Distribución del gasto y proyección de escala con advertencias de encuadre.
85: - Guardado del escenario en el navegador.
86: 
87: ### Proceso
88: - Seis fases con objetivos, tareas, focos de atención y costo estimado.
89: - Checklist legal de Argentina y progreso de tareas.
90: - Enlaces al presupuesto y a la biblioteca.
91: 
92: ## Cómo ejecutarlo
93: 
94: No requiere build ni dependencias:
95: 
96: ```bash
97: python3 -m http.server 3002
98: ```
99: 
100: Abrí `http://localhost:3002/`.
101: 
102: También puede servirse con cualquier servidor estático. El estado se guarda en `localStorage` con la clave `verde-app-v2`.
103: 
104: ## Estructura
105: 
106: ```text
107: index.html      Estructura de las 8 vistas, modales, command palette y navegación
108: styles.css      Sistema visual, shell, dashboard y componentes base
109: views.css       Cepas, diario y simulador
110: panels.css      Biblioteca, oráculo, costos, proceso y responsive
111: verde-v3.css    Overlay compacto: índice, biblioteca digerida, batch, roadmap y ⌘K
112: game.js         Estado, simulador, filtros, render, búsqueda global y eventos
113: roadmap.js      Roadmap v4.3: 14 frentes, 221 hitos, 60 hechos, orden de desarrollo, fuera de alcance, 20 apps, 18 apuestas y 12 brechas
114: library.js      Biblioteca demo, fases, checks legales y base del oráculo
115: strains.js      Catálogo demo de 14 autoflorecientes con category + source anotada
116: assets/         Fotografías locales optimizadas
117: ```
118: 
119: ## Datos, fuentes e imágenes
120: 
121: - La biblioteca y las diplomaturas son un **dataset demo** pensado para mostrar provenance, duplicados y citas. No contiene los PDFs originales.
122: - El alta de PDFs guarda metadatos y nombre de archivo en esta versión. La conversión real a Markdown y la búsqueda semántica quedan como siguiente etapa.
123: - El oráculo es una **heurística local**: no envía documentos a terceros y no es un modelo generativo. Sus respuestas citan recursos del índice.
124: - Las fotografías son imágenes de Unsplash incorporadas como material de demostración. No se copiaron assets, marcas ni interfaces de Leafly, Weedmaps, GrowDiaries u otras apps comerciales; el diseño se inspira en patrones de producto (explorador de cepas, diario, ficha de recurso) sin reproducir su identidad visual.
125: - Los perfiles de cepas son síntesis educativas de referencia. No reemplazan la ficha del banco de semillas.
126: 
127: ## Marco legal y límites
128: 
129: Verde parte de un escenario de autocultivo registrado: hasta 9 plantas y 15 m² en el domicilio declarado, sin fines de lucro. Las condiciones concretas dependen de REPROCANN, la jurisdicción y la normativa vigente en 2026.
130: 
131: La app no constituye asesoramiento legal ni médico. No incluye venta, distribución ni recomendaciones terapéuticas individualizadas. Las proyecciones de valor de cosecha son ejercicios de costeo, no una autorización comercial.
132: 
133: ## Supuestos de esta versión
134: 
135: - Temporada de 75 días y 9 autoflorecientes en 15 m².
136: - Indoor con LED de 240 W, 18 horas de luz y tarifa de $95/kWh.
137: - Rendimiento base de 55 g por planta y precio de referencia de $4.500/g.
138: - Datos persistidos solo en el navegador; no hay backend ni cuentas.
139: - El catálogo y la biblioteca son demostrativos y editables desde la interfaz.

    Cannabis Strain API for Developers

Programmatic access to Strainpedia's structured cannabis cultivar database.

The Strainpedia Cannabis Strain API returns JSON records for published cultivars, including available genetics and lineage, strain type, THC and CBD ranges, cannabinoids, terpenes, reported effects, flavors, aromas, images, and canonical Strainpedia URLs.

Developers can retrieve individual strains, search and compare records, filter numeric THC/CBD ranges, and discover strains by effect, flavor, or terpene. The API is designed for apps, AI tools, research interfaces, directories, WordPress integrations, WooCommerce projects, and other software that needs structured strain data.

    Search Strains

    Send your API key in the request header:

    x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY_HERE

    curl -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY_HERE" \
https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains

  }
})
.then(response => response.json())
.then(data => console.log(data))
.catch(error => console.error(error));

]);

$data = json_decode(wp_remote_retrieve_body($response), true);
  

  
    Pagination, Filtering, and Sorting

    The all-strains and search endpoints return 20 records per page by default. The maximum page_size is 50.

    GET https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains?page=1&page_size=20&strain_type=hybrid&min_thc=15&max_thc=25

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is a cannabis strain API?
    A cannabis strain API gives developers programmatic access to structured strain information. The Strainpedia Cannabis Strain API returns JSON data for strain names, genetics, cannabinoid ranges, terpenes, effects, flavors, aromas, images, URLs, and other supported fields where available.

    Is Strainpedia a cannabis strain database API?
    Yes. Strainpedia provides a cannabis strain database API that developers can use to retrieve structured strain information, including names, genetics, cannabinoid ranges, terpenes, effects, flavors, aromas, images, categories, and canonical source URLs where available.

    Does the cannabis API return JSON?
    Yes. Strainpedia is a REST API that returns structured JSON responses that developers can use in websites, mobile apps, AI tools, search interfaces, directories, WordPress integrations, and other software.

    Can I search and look up cannabis strains through the API?
    Yes. Paid access includes paginated keyword search, an all-strains collection, single-strain lookup by slug, multi-strain comparison, and discovery routes for effects, flavors, and terpenes.

    Does the API include cannabis genetics and lineage?
    Yes, where available. The genetics field provides known or reported genetic lineage for supported strain records. Data availability can vary by cultivar and source.

    Does the cannabis strain API include terpene and cannabinoid data?
    Yes, where available. Supported records can include reported terpene profiles, THC and CBD ranges, normalized numeric THC/CBD boundaries, and nested cannabinoid data. Paid endpoints also support terpene filtering and a dedicated terpene discovery catalog.

    Can I use the cannabis API with WordPress or WooCommerce?

Is the Strainpedia API free?

    Can I filter strains by THC, CBD, effects, flavors, or terpenes?

    Can I cancel anytime?
    Yes. The developer subscription is month-to-month and can be cancelled anytime.

    How many API requests are included?
    The Developer API Plan includes up to 200,000 requests per month.

    Is the WordPress plugin included?
    Yes. The official Strainpedia WordPress Client Pro plugin is included with every active Strainpedia API subscription. It supports Strainpedia Strains, WordPress Posts, WordPress Pages, and WooCommerce Products.

    Does the API include full article content?
    No. Standard API access does not include full article content. The API is designed to provide structured strain data for apps and integrations while protecting Strainpedia’s original editorial content.

    Can I use the data in a commercial app?
    Yes, commercial or app use is allowed while your subscription is active and your usage follows the API terms.

    Can I resell or export the data?
    No. Strainpedia API data may not be copied, resold, bulk-exported, scraped, or republished as a separate database.

    Do I need to credit Strainpedia?
    Yes. Apps and websites using Strainpedia API data must include visible attribution with a link to https://www.strainpedia.com/.

    What happens if I exceed my monthly limit?
    Your API access may stop responding until the next monthly cycle, or you may contact us to discuss a higher-volume plan.

    Can I get a higher request limit?
    Yes. Higher-volume access may be available for approved partners depending on usage needs.

## Objective
- Develop Verde as a personal study app focused on medicinal cannabis in Argentina, with a trustworthy study library and a useful run-based simulator.
- Continue implementing and validating agreed improvements proactively.

## Requirements
- Organize PDF materials by course and folder, with carefully extracted Markdown, metadata, tags, sources, and insights; keep demo content distinct from real processed materials.
- Simulator flow: configure → **SIMULAR** → inspect the full-process timechart and compare 4–5 outcomes; label outcomes as estimates, not predictions.
- Use synthetic model variations, not empirical probabilities or confidence intervals.
- Improve catalog, readability, navigation, responsive layouts, and Argentina-focused manual price references.
- Keep home a simple book-like index; remove random health and seasonal-cost figures.
- Deprioritize diary, gamification, marketplace, login, and social features; track them under “Cosas que harían la app completa pero que no me interesan.”
- Keep the roadmap editable/exportable and aligned with user priorities.

## Decisions
- Verde is a personal study tool, not a game, marketplace, or social network.
- “Vista digerida” surfaces insights from processed Markdown, separate from source-material ingestion.
- Simulator scenarios are illustrative model variations, not predictions or statistical confidence intervals.
- PDF ingestion is browser-local. Displayed `pdf/` and `md/` paths are references; the static app does not write files into repository folders.
- External API research should account for access/key requirements, licensing, attribution, and appropriate handling of data sources.

## Work State
### Completed
- Home rebuilt as a seven-chapter app index; random status/cost indicators removed.
- Library supports course/folder PDF covers, local pdf.js extraction, page progress, metadata/tags, scanned-PDF detection, and Markdown/PDF download controls.
- Library search, Oráculo citations, local annotations, and tag-based reading paths with Markdown export are implemented.
- Reading-path creation uses an inline accessible form; linked-resource detail offers a comparison view without implying that links prove identical contents.
- Catalog groups strains and shows source information; indoor/outdoor cost views include editable prices, product images, and Mercado Libre verification links.
- PWA manifest/service worker and baseline accessibility improvements are present.
- Simulator generates five deterministic seeded runs, ranks them, displays selectable outcome cards, and updates the timechart/process when selected.
- Simulator outcomes are labeled as synthetic estimates, not predictions or probabilities.
- Added IndexedDB storage for uploaded PDF originals and asynchronous PDF download retrieval; ingestion rejects missing, non-PDF, invalid-signature, and over-40-MB files.
- Clean-profile browser verification passed PDF extraction, scanned-PDF pending state, missing-file and invalid-signature errors, IndexedDB persistence/retrieval after reload, and Markdown/PDF downloads after reload.
- External API lookup found StrainAPI public read-only REST API documentation at `https://www.strainapi.com/docs/`, TheCannabisInformer’s free-beta, no-key read-only JSON API page, and Strainpedia’s private developer API page. License and attribution terms still need verification.
- Latest `git status --short`: uncommitted changes in `game.js`, `index.html`, `sw.js`, and `verde-v3.css`; `git diff --stat` reported 188 insertions and 56 deletions. `git diff --check` passed.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `game.js`, `roadmap.js`, and `strains.js`.

### Active
- Verify free API terms, licensing, attribution, and access conditions; document suitable data-source handling.
- Reconcile roadmap counts/statuses and non-priorities with current scope; update `README.md` and `roadmap.js`.
- Run broader desktop/mobile smoke tests and verify simulator outcome-selection behavior in the current build.

### Blocked
- OCR for scanned PDFs is not implemented; parser detects likely image-only PDFs and recommends OCR.
- DuckDuckGo MCP lookup failed because `uvx` is unavailable (`spawn uvx ENOENT`); external API terms remain unverified.

## Next Move
1. Inspect API documentation and terms for StrainAPI, TheCannabisInformer, and Strainpedia; verify licensing/attribution before recommending integration.
2. Update `README.md` and `roadmap.js` to match verified functionality and reconcile roadmap counts, statuses, and out-of-scope priorities.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks, desktop/mobile smoke tests, simulator outcome-selection checks, and rerun the clean-profile PDF suite, reviewing `/tmp/opencode/test_pdf_clean.py` because a later rerun failed at the Markdown download assertion.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Simulator, PDF parsing and IndexedDB storage, library search, annotations, reading paths, comparison view, and cost behavior.
- `index.html`: App views, simulator results/configuration, library, and PDF ingestion interface.
- `verde-v3.css`: Responsive simulator/library styling and UI refinements.
- `sw.js`: Service-worker cache version and assets.
- `roadmap.js`: Roadmap streams, milestones, and status/count logic.
- `README.md`: Project documentation; stale on roadmap counts and implemented PDF behavior.
- `library.js`: Library resources, course metadata, and digest data.
- `strains.js`: Strain catalog and source data.
- `pdf/README.md`: PDF source-directory conventions and demo dataset clarification.
- `md/01_CultivoInterior/M4/03_riego_sustrato.md`: Unverified short Markdown sample.
- `/tmp/opencode/test_pdf_clean.py`: Clean-profile CDP browser verification script.
- `/tmp/opencode/oversize.pdf`: 40 MiB+ fixture used for size-limit validation.

## Important Context
- Roadmap identifies itself as v4.4 (November 2026), while `README.md` still documents v4.3 and conflicting milestone totals.
- The clean-profile test passed extraction, scanned-pending detection, persistence/reload, and download checks previously; a later rerun failed at the Markdown download assertion after earlier checks, so the complete suite is not currently confirmed.
- No reference simulator timechart image is available for exact visual comparison.

**Commercial use is permitted** subject to these API Terms.

Access to the API does not transfer ownership of StrainAPI, its infrastructure, database, website, trademarks, documentation, or other intellectual property to you.

## Cannabis Strain Data Available Through the API

Each response is built from Strainpedia's published cultivar records. Field availability varies by strain, but supported records can expose the following data without requiring developers to scrape or reconstruct the encyclopedia pages.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Internal WordPress post ID |
| `name` | Strain name |
| `slug` | Unique strain URL slug |
| `url` | Canonical Strainpedia page URL |
| `excerpt` | Short public summary of the strain page |
| `featured_image` | Featured strain image URL, when available |
| `categories` | Human-readable category names |
| `category_slugs` | Machine-readable category slugs |
| `type` | Indica, sativa, hybrid, or related classification where available |
| `genetics` | Known or reported genetic lineage where available |
| `thc_range` | Reported THC range where available |
| `cbd_range` | Reported CBD range where available |
| `thc_min` / `thc_max` | Normalized numeric THC boundaries, or `null` when unavailable |
| `cbd_min` / `cbd_max` | Normalized numeric CBD boundaries, or `null` when unavailable |
| `cannabinoids` | Nested THC and CBD objects containing text, minimum, maximum, and unit |
| `terpenes` | Reported terpene profile where available |
| `effects` | Reported effects or use-case notes where available |
| `flavors` | Flavor notes where available |
| `aroma` | Aroma notes where available |
| `flowering_time` | General flowering-time information where available |
| `difficulty` | General grower difficulty notes where available |
| `yield_potential` | General yield potential where available |
| `created_at` | Record publication timestamp in ISO 8601 format |
| `updated_at` | Record modification timestamp in ISO 8601 format |

## Cannabis API Authentication

The Strainpedia API is private and requires an approved developer API key.

Send your API key in the request header:

```

### JavaScript Example

fetch('https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains', {

  }
})
.then(response => response.json())
.then(data => console.log(data))
.catch(error => console.error(error));

$response = wp_remote_get('https://www.strainpedia.com/wp-json/strainpedia/v1/strains', [

]);

$data = json_decode(wp_remote_retrieve_body($response), true);
```

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is a cannabis strain API?

A cannabis strain API gives developers programmatic access to structured strain information. The Strainpedia Cannabis Strain API returns JSON data for strain names, genetics, cannabinoid ranges, terpenes, effects, flavors, aromas, images, URLs, and other supported fields where available.

### Is Strainpedia a cannabis strain database API?

Yes. Strainpedia provides a cannabis strain database API that developers can use to retrieve structured strain information, including names, genetics, cannabinoid ranges, terpenes, effects, flavors, aromas, images, categories, and canonical source URLs where available.

### Does the cannabis API return JSON?

Yes. Strainpedia is a REST API that returns structured JSON responses that developers can use in websites, mobile apps, AI tools, search interfaces, directories, WordPress integrations, and other software.

### Can I search and look up cannabis strains through the API?

Yes. Paid access includes paginated keyword search, an all-strains collection, single-strain lookup by slug, multi-strain comparison, and discovery routes for effects, flavors, and terpenes.

### Does the API include cannabis genetics and lineage?

Yes, where available. The `genetics` field provides known or reported genetic lineage for supported strain records. Data availability can vary by cultivar and source.

### Does the cannabis strain API include terpene and cannabinoid data?

Yes, where available. Supported records can include reported terpene profiles, THC and CBD ranges, normalized numeric THC/CBD boundaries, and nested cannabinoid data. Paid endpoints also support terpene filtering and a dedicated terpene discovery catalog.

### Can I use the cannabis API with WordPress or WooCommerce?

Yes. Active subscribers receive the official Strainpedia WordPress Client Pro plugin, which supports Strainpedia Strains, WordPress Posts, WordPress Pages, and WooCommerce Products.

### Is the Strainpedia API free?

No. The Strainpedia API is offered as a paid developer subscription at $50/month. This helps support hosting, maintenance, development, and ongoing data organization.

### Can I test the API before subscribing?

Yes. Use the [**Strainpedia API Playground**](https://www.strainpedia.com/api-playground/) to test the public demo without a key, explore protected endpoints with a temporary developer key, generate integration code, and download the Developer Starter Kit. Full endpoints require a developer subscription.

### Can I filter strains by THC, CBD, effects, flavors, or terpenes?

Yes. Paid API access supports numeric THC/CBD range filters, strain-type filtering, effect/flavor/terpene filters, pagination, and sorting. Dedicated effects, flavors, and terpenes catalogs also provide stable slugs and matching strain counts.

### Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. The developer subscription is month-to-month and can be cancelled anytime.

### How many API requests are included?

The Developer API Plan includes up to 200,000 requests per month.

### Is the WordPress plugin included?

Yes. The official Strainpedia WordPress Client Pro plugin is included with every active Strainpedia API subscription. It supports Strainpedia Strains, WordPress Posts, WordPress Pages, and WooCommerce Products.

### Does the API include full article content?

No. Standard API access does not include full article content. The API is designed to provide structured strain data for apps and integrations while protecting Strainpedia’s original editorial content.

### Can I use the data in a commercial app?

Yes, commercial or app use is allowed while your subscription is active and your usage follows the API terms.

### Can I resell or export the data?

No. Strainpedia API data may not be copied, resold, bulk-exported, scraped, or republished as a separate database.

### Do I need to credit Strainpedia?

Yes. Apps and websites using Strainpedia API data must include visible attribution with a link to https://www.strainpedia.com/.

### What happens if I exceed my monthly limit?

Your API access may stop responding until the next monthly cycle, or you may contact us to discuss a higher-volume plan.

### Can I get a higher request limit?

Yes. Higher-volume access may be available for approved partners depending on usage needs.

92: ## Cómo ejecutarlo
93: 
94: No requiere build ni dependencias:
95: 
96: ```bash
97: python3 -m http.server 3002
98: ```

101: 
102: También puede servirse con cualquier servidor estático. El estado se guarda en `localStorage` con la clave `verde-app-v2`.
103: 
104: ## Estructura
105: 
106: ```text
107: index.html      Estructura de las 8 vistas, modales, command palette y navegación
108: styles.css      Sistema visual, shell, dashboard y componentes base
109: views.css       Cepas, diario y simulador
110: panels.css      Biblioteca, oráculo, costos, proceso y responsive
111: verde-v3.css    Overlay compacto: índice, biblioteca digerida, batch, roadmap y ⌘K
112: game.js         Estado, simulador, filtros, render, búsqueda global y eventos
113: roadmap.js      Roadmap v4.3: 14 frentes, 221 hitos, 60 hechos, orden de desarrollo, fuera de alcance, 20 apps, 18 apuestas y 12 brechas
114: library.js      Biblioteca demo, fases, checks legales y base del oráculo
115: strains.js      Catálogo demo de 14 autoflorecientes con category + source anotada
116: assets/         Fotografías locales optimizadas
117: ```
118: 
119: ## Datos, fuentes e imágenes
120: 
121: - La biblioteca y las diplomaturas son un **dataset demo** pensado para mostrar provenance, duplicados y citas. No contiene los PDFs originales.
122: - El alta de PDFs guarda metadatos y nombre de archivo en esta versión. La conversión real a Markdown y la búsqueda semántica quedan como siguiente etapa.
123: - El oráculo es una **heurística local**: no envía documentos a terceros y no es un modelo generativo. Sus respuestas citan recursos del índice.
124: - Las fotografías son imágenes de Unsplash incorporadas como material de demostración. No se copiaron assets, marcas ni interfaces de Leafly, Weedmaps, GrowDiaries u otras apps comerciales; el diseño se inspira en patrones de producto (explorador de cepas, diario, ficha de recurso) sin reproducir su identidad visual.
125: - Los perfiles de cepas son síntesis educativas de referencia. No reemplazan la ficha del banco de semillas.
126: 
127: ## Marco legal y límites
128: 
129: Verde parte de un escenario de autocultivo registrado: hasta 9 plantas y 15 m² en el domicilio declarado, sin fines de lucro. Las condiciones concretas dependen de REPROCANN, la jurisdicción y la normativa vigente en 2026.
130: 
131: La app no constituye asesoramiento legal ni médico. No incluye venta, distribución ni recomendaciones terapéuticas individualizadas. Las proyecciones de valor de cosecha son ejercicios de costeo, no una autorización comercial.
132: 
133: ## Supuestos de esta versión
134: 
135: - Temporada de 75 días y 9 autoflorecientes en 15 m².
136: - Indoor con LED de 240 W, 18 horas de luz y tarifa de $95/kWh.
137: - Rendimiento base de 55 g por planta y precio de referencia de $4.500/g.
138: - Datos persistidos solo en el navegador; no hay backend ni cuentas.
139: - El catálogo y la biblioteca son demostrativos y editables desde la interfaz.
